- Horizontal: row r, cols [c-9, c+9]

- center_row = dr and |center_col - dc| <= 9, OR

- (24, 40): center at (24, 40) or (r, 40) where |r-24|<=9, or (24, c) where |c-40|<=9
- (24, 53): center at (24, 53) or (r, 53) where |r-24|<=9, or (24, c) where |c-53|<=9
- (35, 48): center at (35, 48) or (r, 48) where |r-35|<=9, or (35, c) where |c-48|<=9
From blue cross center (45, 36):
- To (48, 36): DOWN 1 → center at (48, 36). Vertical arm covers col 36, rows 39-57. Doesn't help much.
- Better approach: move to positions that cover multiple dots.
Looking at the dots:
- (24, 40) and (24, 53) are on the same row (row 24). If center is at (24, c) with |c-40|<=9 and |c-53|<=9, that means c in [31, 49] and c in [44, 62], so c in [44, 49]. Center at (24, 48) would work! Horizontal arm covers cols 39-57, which includes both 40 and 53.

- But center at (24, 48) would collect (24, 40) and (24, 53) via horizontal arm.

- From (24, 48), to collect (35, 48): vertical arm covers rows 15-33, row 35 is outside. Need to move down.
- Center at (33, 48): vertical arm covers rows 24-42, includes both 24 and 35. Horizontal arm covers cols 39-57, includes 40 and 53. So center at (33, 48) collects ALL 4 dots!
From blue cross at (45, 36) to (33, 48):
- Row: 45 → 33, delta = -12, that's 4 UP
- Col: 36 → 48, delta = +12, that's 4 RIGHT
So: SPACE, then UP 4, RIGHT 4. That should collect all 4 blue dots!
